unit: S81-10b LINKS-GATE (ENABLE_FRAGRANCE_ONLY_GATE, shared with S81-10; FOCUS unit, quota / refund surface)
summary:
I wrote the spec at base c6fb6533 in the detached worktree sc-s81-s10b. It is 76,218 B, pure ASCII, LF, and sits in the gitignored .qa-s80/. I assembled it through the shell from spec_part1-3.txt in my scratchpad. git status --short was empty before and after, and HEAD is unchanged.

Measured findings that change the brief:

1. compare_from_urls makes no specs, price or reviews fetches after the resolve. The only paid call after the decision point is generate_comparison (:1361). The gate therefore goes between _resolve_pair_category (:1343-1345) and the pair write-back (:1346-1347). It must come before the write-back, or a mixed pair loses its per-product categories.
2. The structured extractors never set a category. The extraction LLM runs only when the title or the price is missing (:1075, :1158). So a JSON-LD product page normalizes to category 'other'.
   - The URL resolver uses parser_path=True and never calls A2b.
   - As merged, post_resolve_refusal therefore lets every no-chip JSON-LD link pair through without classifying it. A probe with dotenv stubbed (no .env read, no network) confirmed this: no chip or the chip 'other' gives 0 classify calls and the pair proceeds; a real chip gives 1 call and the pair is refused.
   - The spec adds a keyword-only resolver_classified=False to post_resolve_refusal (default True, so S81-10 callers are byte-identical). It sends a blind pair to the evidence-or-one-A2b arm whatever the chip.
3. log_budget_spent maps an unknown route label to 'image'. _ROUTE_LABELS gains url.post and url.get.
4. The URL failure arm already maps a CATEGORY_NOT_LIVE result to the 400 with the category keys: url_routes:299-302, then text_routes:557-561, then error_handler:214-227. No mapping edit is needed. The comment at text_routes:558-560 ('url_routes never produces it') goes stale (Q4).
5. S81-10 P02's URL clause is a source needle scan at tests/test_s81_s10_fragrance_gate.py:2291-2294, not an HTTP row. EK1 deletes those 4 lines.
6. Design:
   - The handler reads the flag once, through category_gate.fragrance_only_gate_enabled, then checks the admin mark.
   - When the gate is on it passes gate_route to _compare_urls_metered, whose first statement is the budget check: one MGET, a 429 never billed. That check sits after the SSRF and B4 pre-gate 400s and before the S81-06 consent 503 and the reserve.
   - compare_from_urls(*, fragrance_gate) runs rule 1 on the extracted '<brand> <name>' texts (the camera precedent, Q1), then post_resolve_refusal per product (form override, GC-2, GC-1 rewrite).
   - A refusal is counted with one EVAL, logged as 'refused stage=post_extract', returned as refusal_result, and refunded once by the base failure arm.
7. Rows: 18 RED (about 29 nodes) and 6 PIN (about 31 nodes). P01 is a new golden of 18 scenarios × 5 OFF spellings with raising recorders.
8. Mutants M01-M28 each have named killing rows. Two are declared equivalent: M-EQ1 (an added apply_form_override_stubs call) and M-EQ2 (reading request.state before the flag).
9. Comm set: 96 runnable files with the Q4 comment edit, 75 without (lists and classes in scratchpad S81_10B_COMM_*). No base record exists yet at c6fb6533.
10. Base: 4 bounded runs over 31 pin files, 3,321 passed. There is 1 environmental failure, test_r06_production_lexicon_content: the fresh worktree checks out data/fragrance_lexicon.json with CRLF under core.autocrlf=true.

Not done: no RED file, golden, prototype or mutant run; no base record; no client fences.

open_questions: Q1 Should rule 1 run on the extracted '<brand> <name>' texts? Default yes. The camera does the same after its paid vision call (R-S10-13), it saves the A2b call on obvious titles, and it keeps them refused during a classifier outage. Alternative: post_resolve only (the brief's literal step 2); drop R12 and M10.

Q2 The blind arm: keyword-only resolver_classified=False on post_resolve_refusal (default True, S81-10 callers unchanged). The probe shows the hole without it. Alternative with no category_gate edit: pass CATEGORIES_LIVE[0] as the chip argument on the URL call (same behaviour, opaque call site).
Q3 Widen _ROUTE_LABELS with url.post and url.get? Default yes; otherwise the link budget line logs route=image. Alternative: a url_routes-local log line.
Q4 Rewrite the stale text_routes.py:558-560 comment in place? Default yes (comment only; the comm set grows from 75 to 96 files). Alternative: leave it as stated limit L16.
Q5 Read the budget before the S81-06 consent 503? Default yes, matching the text and camera order; this only changes which code a consent-refused client with a spent budget sees.

Q6 L4 on links: a blind page beside a fragrance page proceeds as a fragrance. This is more frequent on links because JSON-LD pages are blind. Default: inherited stated limit and the first canary read (S81-10c). Alternative: one per-product A2b in this unit.
Q7 EK1 timing: GREEN applies E1 in its commit; the RED gate measures P02 red on the prototype without E1 and green with it.
Q8 Confirm the ruling wording: the brief calls P02's URL clause an HTTP row, but it is a source needle scan (:2291-2294).
Q9 The brief's 'specs / price / reviews fetches after the resolution' do not exist; the only paid call after the decision is generate_comparison. Confirm L1's wording.
Q10 The new RED reuses the S81-10 RED module's harness by import (the gate-rows precedent) rather than a self-contained copy. Confirm.

stated_limits: L1 The paid extraction (two page fetches, plus the extraction LLM only when title or price is missing) precedes the decision; refunded to the user, bounded by the budget and the limiter; the verdict never runs on a refusal
L2 No slug scan; the only pre-consume exit for a link pair is the budget 429
L3 Blind JSON-LD pairs cost one A2b unless the lexicon finds evidence; an A2b failure proceeds uncounted
L4 (inherited) A blind page beside a fragrance page proceeds as a fragrance (S81-10c)
L5 GC-2 on links: a blind pair with house evidence proceeds without a classifier
L6 A proceeding blind pair keeps the resolver's category_used (the client chip when no extraction LLM ran)
L7 Under B4 the decision runs inside the 25 s deadline; an expiry there is a TIMEOUT and the refusal is not counted
L8 Build 3 shows the generic copy; the 429 never opens the Paywall; the flip waits for the S81-11 OTA
L9 The budget fails open; one more Upstash round trip and up to 3 lexicon os.stat calls per gated link compare
L10 The admin bypass holds only while ENABLE_COMPARE_AUTH_REQUIRED is ON
L11 A refusal writes the base W4-13 failure row with the refusal copy; no history row, no lifetime bump, no capture_result_status
L12 The extraction LLM's category is trusted when it ran
L14 The A2b and the form override read the product name only; the evidence reads '<brand> <name>'
L15 The post-extract refusal line carries no route label
L16 (only if Q4 is ruled out) the text_routes comment stays stale
